source: MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy
text: Members who meet the requirements of their membership class are considered Active. Active Status also includes members on Leave of Absence, Non-Participating (LOA-A) and Leave of Absence, Participating (LOA-B).
link: <https://minnesotarollerderby.groups.io/g/main/files/Admin/Policies/Current%20Articles,%20Bylaws%20and%20Misc.%20Policies/MNRD%20Membership%20Policy%20%28updated23Mar2026%29.pdff|MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy>

source: MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy
text: A member who has an approved Leave of Absence, Non-Participating (LOA-A), from MNRD HR and is temporarily unable to meet the requirements of their membership class due to personal, medical, or other circumstances is considered LOA-A status.
link: <https://minnesotarollerderby.groups.io/g/main/files/Admin/Policies/Current%20Articles,%20Bylaws%20and%20Misc.%20Policies/MNRD%20Membership%20Policy%20%28updated23Mar2026%29.pdff|MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy>

source: MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy
text: Members who do not anticipate participating in league responsibilities during their leave should generally request LOA-A.
link: <https://minnesotarollerderby.groups.io/g/main/files/Admin/Policies/Current%20Articles,%20Bylaws%20and%20Misc.%20Policies/MNRD%20Membership%20Policy%20%28updated23Mar2026%29.pdff|MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy>

source: MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy
text: After 12 consecutive months on LOA-A, members automatically transition to Inactive status. Members should consider whether an LOA-A or formal retirement with the intent to return is more appropriate.
link: <https://minnesotarollerderby.groups.io/g/main/files/Admin/Policies/Current%20Articles,%20Bylaws%20and%20Misc.%20Policies/MNRD%20Membership%20Policy%20%28updated23Mar2026%29.pdff|MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy>

source: MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy
text: Members must request a status change to LOA-A through MNRD HR.
link: <https://minnesotarollerderby.groups.io/g/main/files/Admin/Policies/Current%20Articles,%20Bylaws%20and%20Misc.%20Policies/MNRD%20Membership%20Policy%20%28updated23Mar2026%29.pdff|MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy>

source: MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy
text: The LOA-A becomes effective only after approval from HR and notification to the member, their program(s) leadership, and their committee(s) oversight.
link: <https://minnesotarollerderby.groups.io/g/main/files/Admin/Policies/Current%20Articles,%20Bylaws%20and%20Misc.%20Policies/MNRD%20Membership%20Policy%20%28updated23Mar2026%29.pdff|MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy>

source: MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy
text: HR must complete the review and communicate the results to the requesting member within 7 days of receiving the request
link: <https://minnesotarollerderby.groups.io/g/main/files/Admin/Policies/Current%20Articles,%20Bylaws%20and%20Misc.%20Policies/MNRD%20Membership%20Policy%20%28updated23Mar2026%29.pdff|MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy>

source: MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy
text: LOA-As must last at least 14 days and no more than 3 months. They may be renewed in 3-month increments, up to 12 consecutive months.
link: <https://minnesotarollerderby.groups.io/g/main/files/Admin/Policies/Current%20Articles,%20Bylaws%20and%20Misc.%20Policies/MNRD%20Membership%20Policy%20%28updated23Mar2026%29.pdff|MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy>

source: MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy
text: After 12 months on LOA-A, members automatically move to Inactive status.
link: <https://minnesotarollerderby.groups.io/g/main/files/Admin/Policies/Current%20Articles,%20Bylaws%20and%20Misc.%20Policies/MNRD%20Membership%20Policy%20%28updated23Mar2026%29.pdff|MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy>

source: MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy
text: LOA-A status may be backdated up to 21 days.
link: <https://minnesotarollerderby.groups.io/g/main/files/Admin/Policies/Current%20Articles,%20Bylaws%20and%20Misc.%20Policies/MNRD%20Membership%20Policy%20%28updated23Mar2026%29.pdff|MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy>

source: MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy
text: Members are required to pay dues as required by their membership class unless they have a waiver approved by the MNRD Board of Directors (BOD).
link: <https://minnesotarollerderby.groups.io/g/main/files/Admin/Policies/Current%20Articles,%20Bylaws%20and%20Misc.%20Policies/MNRD%20Membership%20Policy%20%28updated23Mar2026%29.pdff|MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy>

source: MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy
text: Members are not required to fulfill their job requirements but must communicate with their overseeing committee to facilitate the handoff of those responsibilities.
link: <https://minnesotarollerderby.groups.io/g/main/files/Admin/Policies/Current%20Articles,%20Bylaws%20and%20Misc.%20Policies/MNRD%20Membership%20Policy%20%28updated23Mar2026%29.pdff|MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy>

source: MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy
text: Members retain access to MNRD league communication channels and applicable program practices.
link: <https://minnesotarollerderby.groups.io/g/main/files/Admin/Policies/Current%20Articles,%20Bylaws%20and%20Misc.%20Policies/MNRD%20Membership%20Policy%20%28updated23Mar2026%29.pdff|MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy>

source: MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy

source: MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy
text: Upon return, members have up to three months to meet all membership requirements (other than dues, unless a waiver applies).

text: Members who fail to meet the requirements of their membership class are considered Inactive. For classes without defined requirements, this determination is made by that class's leadership.

source: MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy
text: A member's status automatically changes to Inactive when they no longer meet the requirements of their membership class.
link: <https://minnesotarollerderby.groups.io/g/main/files/Admin/Policies/Current%20Articles,%20Bylaws%20and%20Misc.%20Policies/MNRD%20Membership%20Policy%20%28updated23Mar2026%29.pdff|MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy>

source: MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy
text: HR will notify the member of the intent to change their status and grant a two-week grace period to comply or make a reasonable-faith effort to do so.
link: <https://minnesotarollerderby.groups.io/g/main/files/Admin/Policies/Current%20Articles,%20Bylaws%20and%20Misc.%20Policies/MNRD%20Membership%20Policy%20%28updated23Mar2026%29.pdff|MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy>

source: MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy
text: Inactive members forfeit all membership benefits. Inactive members do not count towards quorum for voting purposes.
link: <https://minnesotarollerderby.groups.io/g/main/files/Admin/Policies/Current%20Articles,%20Bylaws%20and%20Misc.%20Policies/MNRD%20Membership%20Policy%20%28updated23Mar2026%29.pdff|MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy>

source: MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy
text: After 90 days of Inactive status, members automatically transition to Retired status.
link: <https://minnesotarollerderby.groups.io/g/main/files/Admin/Policies/Current%20Articles,%20Bylaws%20and%20Misc.%20Policies/MNRD%20Membership%20Policy%20%28updated23Mar2026%29.pdff|MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy>

source: MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy
text: Members must meet or make a reasonable-faith effort to meet their membership class requirements to regain Active status.
link: <https://minnesotarollerderby.groups.io/g/main/files/Admin/Policies/Current%20Articles,%20Bylaws%20and%20Misc.%20Policies/MNRD%20Membership%20Policy%20%28updated23Mar2026%29.pdff|MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy>

source: MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy
text: A person who no longer participates as an MNRD member and has filed a Retired status request with HR.
link: <https://minnesotarollerderby.groups.io/g/main/files/Admin/Policies/Current%20Articles,%20Bylaws%20and%20Misc.%20Policies/MNRD%20Membership%20Policy%20%28updated23Mar2026%29.pdff|MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy>

source: MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy
subsection: Retired while in Active status and met all membership class requirements before retiring
text: A person who no longer participates as an MNRD member and has filed a Retired status request with HR.
link: <https://minnesotarollerderby.groups.io/g/main/files/Admin/Policies/Current%20Articles,%20Bylaws%20and%20Misc.%20Policies/MNRD%20Membership%20Policy%20%28updated23Mar2026%29.pdff|MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy>

source: MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy
subsection: Retired while in Active status and met all membership class requirements before retiring
text: A member who retires under the following circumstances: while in inactive status, owing money to the league, while under investiagion by MNRD HR or with an open HR case regarding their behavior, having been removed by MNRD due to the results of an HR investigation.
link: <https://minnesotarollerderby.groups.io/g/main/files/Admin/Policies/Current%20Articles,%20Bylaws%20and%20Misc.%20Policies/MNRD%20Membership%20Policy%20%28updated23Mar2026%29.pdff|MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy>

source: MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy
subsection: Retired while in Active status and met all membership class requirements before retiring
text: A Retired member wishing to rejoin MNRD must first resolve all issues that led to their ineligible retirement, such as paying outstanding dues, completing investigation-related requirements, or meeting membership class obligations.
link: <https://minnesotarollerderby.groups.io/g/main/files/Admin/Policies/Current%20Articles,%20Bylaws%20and%20Misc.%20Policies/MNRD%20Membership%20Policy%20%28updated23Mar2026%29.pdff|MNRD Leave of Absence and Inactivity Policy>
